meta.title: AgentBridge — Supabase Remote MCP Connector Architecture
meta.subtitle: Streamable HTTP Transport, OAuth PKCE / PAT Credentials & Read-Only Policy Boundary
meta.description: System architecture of Phase 7.8C Supabase Remote MCP Connector in AgentBridge. Details CLI / agent callers, ConnectorRegistry lifecycle management, SupabaseMCPConnector adapter with project scoping and feature filtering, MCPOAuthClient and SupabaseCredentialProvider with OS Keyring / environment precedence, MCPClient / MCPSession protocol engine, HttpMCPTransport Streamable HTTP dispatch to https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp, PolicyEngine risk boundaries enforcing read-only defaults, and SQLite ActivityStore audit correlation.

components.label:
AgentBridge CLI / Runtime / Telegram
(sutra/connectors/cli.py)
components.description: User-facing CLI commands (add, auth, test, status, tools, remove) and autonomous agent callers.

components.label:
ConnectorRegistry
(sutra/connectors/registry.py)
components.description: Central lifecycle coordinator managing connector registration, persistent configuration, and state transitions.

components.label:
SupabaseCredentialProvider
(sutra/credentials.py)
components.description: Resolves tokens across Memory > Instance Env > Primary Env > Fallback Env > Keyring with OAuth token refresh.

components.label:
MCPOAuthClient
(sutra/connectors/mcp/oauth.py)
components.description: Reusable OAuth 2.0 PKCE engine with dynamic loopback server listener (127.0.0.1:<port>) and code exchange.

components.label:
OS Keyring Backend
(Windows Credential Manager / Keychain / Secret Service)
components.description: Operating system credential store safeguarding tokens and refresh tokens without plaintext storage.

components.label:
SupabaseMCPConnector
(sutra/connectors/mcp/supabase.py)
components.description: Domain adapter wrapping MCPConnector, validating project_ref, enforcing read_only=true, and encoding query parameters.

components.label:
MCPClient
(sutra/connectors/mcp/client.py)
components.description: Protocol client executing tools/list and tools/call.

components.label:
MCPSession
(sutra/connectors/mcp/session.py)
components.description: Maintains protocol state FSM and negotiates MCP versions (2026-07-28, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05).

components.label:
HttpMCPTransport
(sutra/connectors/mcp/http.py)
components.description: Remote Streamable HTTP transport over HTTPS with Authorization: Bearer header injection.

components.label:
Official Supabase Remote MCP Server
(https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp)
components.description: Official hosted Supabase MCP endpoint exposing database, docs, and schema inspection tools.

components.label:
PolicyEngine
(sutra/policy_engine.py)
components.description: Centralized policy engine rejecting mutating tools under read_only=True and evaluating risk levels.

components.label:
ActivityStore
(sutra/activity_store.py)
components.description: Local SQLite audit trail recording tool call executions correlated by request_id without secret tokens.

relationships.label: Streamable HTTP with project_ref & read_only params
